changelog:
- Eliminated Visuals & Videos Duplicates: Strict Set-based deduplication and procedural seed expansion prevents duplicate images, repeated thumbnails, or repeated stream titles across infinite scrolling feeds.
- Pinterest Fullscreen Lightbox for Images: Tap any image to inspect in full resolution with Set Wallpaper, Download, and Share.
- 3-Dots Action Sheet for Videos: Ad-free play, native sharing, link copying, and download support.
- Fixed Audio Categories Section: Elevated search and category tag strip to a fixed header to prevent clipping behind cards.
- Advanced Audio Features: Liked Songs playlist, continuous auto-play next track, artist-related track search, and MP3 downloads.
- Home Screen Live Playing Music Card: Displays real-time now-playing track with animated equalizer bars, play/pause, stop, and dismiss right below Home Essentials and above Manage Shortcuts.
- Clean Typography: Removed basic emojis and sparkles across media hubs, toasts, and buttons.
